svg.aria-label: Back-end and cloud. Services and apps on AWS, in Python, Node.js, React and Next.js: Linux servers on EC2, microservices on ECS Fargate, provisioning with Terraform and CloudFormation. Docker, CI/CD and APIs with FastAPI and Swagger. Git on GitHub and GitLab. Technologies: Python, Node.js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Docker, Linux, AWS, CloudFormation, Terraform, CI/CD, GitHub, GitLab.
